contentText:
Hazel Gandhi / Rest of World :

Nonprofit What To Fix says Facebook's content monetization program grew from under 3M to over 12M participants in just over a year; 8M+ accounts are in English   —  And Indonesian creators are leading the charge.  —  Facebook's new content monetization program is booming …
